clues: This town is in north Argentina. It sits at the north tip of the Rio Negro province, near La Pampa.
Summers here are hot and dry. Winters bring a dry, strong wind, and snow is rare in this dry land.
Oil came here in nineteen fifty-nine. The state oil firm set up wells nearby, and the town grew fast.
This town took its name from a chief. Tales say he stood up for the state in fights with other native groups.
Today one oil giant runs most of the work here. Petrobras has put big funds into this town.
